hero.title:
Suppliers, Orders, and Stock.
Connected.
hero.description: Manage suppliers, create purchase orders, receive goods, and watch stock levels adjust automatically — no spreadsheets, no double-entry.

mockPO.title: PO #0042 — Nordic Supply Co
mockPO.annotation: Purchase orders link directly to your product catalog. Receiving updates stock in real time — even for partial deliveries.

benefits.title: Supplier directory
benefits.desc: Track suppliers, contact details, payment terms, and order history. Know who delivers what and when.

benefits.title: Purchase orders
benefits.desc: Create POs from low-stock alerts or manual requests. Line items link to your product catalog.

benefits.title: Receiving & stock
benefits.desc: Mark items as received. Stock levels update automatically. Partial deliveries tracked.

scenario: Your warehouse flags low stock on flex connectors. VOIS creates a draft PO to your preferred supplier with the right quantities and pricing from your last order. You approve with one tap. When the delivery arrives, your team marks items received and inventory updates instantly.

cta.title:
From reorder to restocked.
One system.
